lead_story: The Fed's interest-rate decisions are in focus due to high oil prices and inflation concerns. The recent inflation slowdown to 3.5% in June may give the Fed room to maneuver. However, Fed Chairman Warsh faces an inflation credibility test after Congress hearings, which will be closely watched by markets.
